title: Impl: Python multi-gateway route validation
description: When Python RPL stack receives DIOs from multiple gateways, compare root identity and DODAG version. If one gateway advertises a different root or version inconsistent with majority, log warning and deprioritize that gateway in parent selection. File: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py or dao_manager.py. Verify: cd python && python -m pytest tests/test_rpl*.py -x
